notes:
**A page size Docket could not finish measuring is now reported as a floor, not a fact.**

Docket stops reading any single response at 8 MB. On a page larger than that, the number it had been printing was its own ceiling — so a document of 10.2 MB was described as "8.4 MB", precisely and wrongly, in the finding about Google's 2 MB fetch limit and again in the page-weight finding.

Both now say **"at least"**, and only when the read was actually cut short: every page Docket reads to the end still reports an exact size. The audit JSON carries the same distinction, so anything consuming the file can tell a measurement from a lower bound.

Found by auditing a live site and noticing that the reported figure was a round power of two.
